units.source_text: 你们现在的年轻人觉得十分可笑的事，那时对于我来说，则是天大的困难。

en.t: Things that young people like you now would find utterly laughable were, at that time, enormous difficulties for me.

units.source_text: 即便在旅途中，我也和在家里时一样胆怯。

en.t: Even while traveling, I was just as timid as I had been at home.

units.source_text: 尽管我一直在观察K，寻找合适的机会，可他那清高倨傲的神态，总是让我望而却步。

en.t: Although I kept watching K and looking for the right opportunity, his aloof and proud manner always made me draw back.

units.source_text: 我觉得他的心脏好似被涂了一层厚厚的黑漆一般，我试图注入的血液，一滴也没能渗进他的心脏，全都被反弹了回来。

en.t: It seemed to me that his heart was coated with a thick layer of black lacquer; not a single drop of the blood I tried to pour into it could seep inside, and all of it was thrown back.

units.source_text: 不过，K表现得异常刚强的时候，我反而放了心，并且后悔自己的多疑，在心里对K道歉。

en.t: At times, however, when K appeared unusually strong, I was instead reassured, regretted my own suspicion, and apologized to K in my heart.

units.source_text: 感到内疚的同时，又觉得自己就像个卑鄙小人，而突然厌恶起自己来。

en.t: As I felt guilty, I also saw myself as a contemptible little person and suddenly came to loathe myself.

units.source_text: 可是过了一阵子，曾经的疑心又凶猛地卷土重来。

en.t: But after a little while, my former suspicions came surging back with fierce force.

units.source_text: 由于一切都是由疑心推论出来的，因而会觉得无论哪方面都对我不利。

en.t: Because everything was reasoned out from suspicion, every aspect of it seemed unfavorable to me.

units.source_text: 首先K的长相好像就比我讨女人喜欢，而且他那不像我那样小家子气的个性，对异性肯定更有吸引力。

en.t: To begin with, K's looks seemed more likely than mine to appeal to women, and his personality, not petty like mine, must surely have been more attractive to the opposite sex.

units.source_text: 就连他那憨厚的样子，都透着值得信赖的男子气，把我比了下去。

en.t: Even his simple, honest manner carried a trustworthy masculinity that made me seem inferior by comparison.

units.source_text: 至于学业，虽然专业不同，但我也自知无法与K匹敌。

en.t: As for studies, although our fields were different, I knew myself that I could not rival K.

units.source_text: 总之，他所有的优点一下子都展现在我眼前，

en.t: In short, all of his merits suddenly spread out before my eyes,

units.source_text: 致使我那刚刚踏实点儿的心，又回到了不安之中。

en.t: and my heart, which had only just grown a little calmer, returned once more to uneasiness.
